shots.reason: Place, and the distance between the brothers

narration.ti: ኣብ ሓንቲ ዓዲ ዶግዓ ትግራይ፡ ወልደቻኣልን ተስፋይን ዝበሃሉ ክልተ ኣሕዋት ይነብሩ ነበሩ።
narration.en: In a highland village in Tigray, there lived two brothers, Weldechael and Tesfay.

shots.reason: Love in action #1: he will not take part without his brother
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot inside a stone house during a family gathering: food laid out on a woven mesob basket table, people seated around it, one man standing apart near the doorway, not joining, waiting.
shots.motion_prompt: Locked-off camera; the seated people settle while the standing man waits.

narration.ti: ኣብ ዝኾነ ምትእኽኻብ፡ ሓደ ብዘይ እቲ ሓደ ኣየብዕልን ነይሩ።
narration.en: At every gathering, neither would celebrate without the other.

shots.reason: The request: he sends for his brother and waits
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the man turning to the people around him and speaking, gesturing gently toward the open door, soft daylight from the doorway.
shots.motion_prompt: Slight push-in on his face as he speaks.

narration.ti: «ወልደቻኣል ሓወይ ፀውዕዎ» ይብል ነይሩ፡ ክሳዕ ሓዉ ዝመጽእ ድማ ይጽበ።
narration.en: "Call my brother Weldechael," he would say, and wait until he came.

shots.reason: The wait ends; they are always together
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot inside the stone house: the elder brother arrives through the doorway with his walking stick, the younger brother greets him, and they sit down together at the mesob with bread, honey and fresh cheese.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan following the elder brother as he enters and sits.

narration.ti: ሓዉ ምስ መጸ ጥራይ እዩ ዘብዕል ነይሩ።
narration.en: Only when his brother arrived would he join the celebration.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up insert of hands: one man's hand gently feeding the other a bite of injera (gursha), warm light, the mesob basket softly out of focus behind.
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera; the hands move slowly.

narration.en: Their love was seen in what they did.

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot at dusk turning to night: the two brothers walk side by side on a stone path through the highlands, one holding a kerosene lantern, the homestead behind them.
shots.motion_prompt: Camera tracks slowly alongside the walking brothers; the lantern flame flickers.

narration.ti: ምሸት ምስ ኮነ፡ ወልደቻኣል ንተስፋይ ክሳዕ ገዝኡ የሰንዮ።
narration.en: When night fell, Weldechael walked Tesfay home.

shots.reason: The loop begins: they take turns
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot at night by the door of a stone homestead: the younger brother turns back toward the path beside his elder brother, warm lantern light, moonlight.
shots.motion_prompt: Locked-off camera; the younger brother turns and steps back onto the path.

narration.ti: ተስፋይ ግን ሓዉ ንበይኑ ክምለስ ኣይፈቐደን፤ መሊሱ ኣሰነዮ።
narration.en: But Tesfay would not let him return alone, and walked him back.

shots.reason: The loop repeats; the night deepens
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot later at night, the moon high: at the door of the other, near-identical stone homestead, the elder brother turns back to walk with the younger brother again, lantern light.
shots.motion_prompt: Locked-off camera; the elder brother turns and steps back onto the path.

narration.ti: ኣብ ገዛ ወልደቻኣል ምስ በጽሑ ድማ፡ ወልደቻኣል ከም ብሓድሽ ንተስፋይ ኣሰነዮ።
narration.en: And at Weldechael's door, Weldechael walked Tesfay back again.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the two brothers' faces side by side in warm lantern light at night, both smiling with deep affection.
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow push-in; lantern light flickers on their faces.

shots.reason: Night turns into dawn; they never said goodbye
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot at first light: the sky pales from deep blue to soft dawn over the mountain ridge; the two brothers still walk side by side on the stone path, the lantern still glowing.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow tilt up from the walking brothers to the brightening sky.

narration.ti: ከምኡ እናበሉ ለይቲ ምሉእ ክሳዕ ወጋሕታ ክመላለሱ ሓደሩ፡ ።
narration.en: And so they walked back and forth all night, until dawn.

shots.reason: The story lives on in those who heard it
shots.image_prompt: Extreme wide shot in full daylight: an empty stone path winding across the highland valley between two distant stone homesteads, peaceful and still.
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow pull-out; a light breeze moves the grass.

narration.ti: እዚ ዛንታ ክዓቢ ከለኹ ዝሰማዕክዎ እዩ። ሓቀኛ ሃብቲ፡ ኣብ ጎንና ዝጓዓዙ ሰባት እዮም።
narration.en: A story I grew up hearing. True wealth is the people who walk beside us.
